name: Sofia Ramirez
bio:
Sofia's passion for motorsport ignited during her childhood, watching Formula 1 races with her grandfather. This early exposure fueled her ambition to contribute to the sport, leading her to pursue a degree in finance with a focus on motorsports business management. Eager to apply her academic knowledge in a practical setting, Sofia is determined to master the intricacies of motorsport finance. She is committed to maintaining meticulous financial records and leveraging data-driven insights to optimize team resources.

Approaching her role with a blend of analytical rigor and creative problem-solving, Sofia is determined to innovate financial strategies and drive sustainable growth. Her goal is to contribute to the financial stability of the team, enabling them to focus on performance on the track. Sofia understands the critical role of financial management in motorsport, and she is ready to tackle challenges with determination.

Sofia's meticulous nature and ability to identify areas for cost optimization, even under pressure, set her apart. Her unwavering commitment to accuracy and dedication to her role will make her a valuable asset to any team looking to make strategic financial decisions.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair often pulled back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Sofia is petite with a focused gaze and a determined set to her jaw.
